name: Example project config
about: One site's own settings, kept in its repository next to the CI job: what to hide, and why, and the site's own tracking endpoint. Each suppression needs a reason, and the report lists them all.

rules.title: The first-party collector isn't on the site
rules.fix: Check the server-side GTM container is published and its loader is in the page template.

rules.title: The thank-you page doesn't send the generate_lead event
rules.fix: Check the GTM trigger for generate_lead fires on the thank-you page.

suppress.reason: Thank-you pages stay out of search on purpose.
